package.description: A multiplayer environment for coding with teammates and agents.

en-US.author: Zed Industries, Inc.
en-US.description: A multiplayer environment for coding with teammates and agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Delta brings teammates and coding agents into one shared thread. Your conversations and code live in the same place, and every change is anchored to the reasoning behind it, so the decisions and prompts that produced the code stay readable alongside the results.
Work in the Delta app or from your terminal; DeltaDB keeps both in the same thread. The version control system records every edit with the conversation behind it, and a thread shared from Claude Code can be joined from the Delta app, and the other way around.
Invite teammates into the same thread to review, comment, and work alongside the agent in real time. Comment on the conversation or any line of code, and the feedback stays anchored as the work evolves.
en-US.name: Delta
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ New this release
- The agent can now keep commands such as dev servers running in the background and is told when they finish, and Send to Background moves a running agent command there yourself.
- Selecting text in file panes and diff views now highlights other occurrences of the same text.
- Enable Show Branch Diff Stats in desktop Sidebar settings to see last-known added and deleted line counts beside threads you’ve opened, compared with each project’s default base branch.
- You can now choose Fork Thread or Start Review from the conversation’s right-click menu.
- Right-click files in the Changes panel to copy their paths or open and reveal local files.
- Subthreads can now be dragged to reorder them under their parent thread in the sidebar.
- In threads with multiple projects, use Switch Terminal in the terminal header to switch terminals or open a new one.
- Use Expand Child Threads from the command palette or View menu to show the current thread’s child rows in the sidebar.
- Clear merge indicators from a thread and its nested subthreads with Clear Merge Indicators in the thread’s context menu.
- Use Open Organization Overview and Switch Organization in the desktop command palette to browse your organization’s threads or switch organizations without the mouse.
- Owners and admins of a team organization can now open its dashboard page with Manage Organization in the organization menu.
- LLM Providers settings now label each provider’s designated fast model, with a tooltip explaining which Delta features use it.
⚡ Better than before
- Delta’s default light and dark themes now use softer surfaces and more neutral text colors.
- Changes to your role or membership in an organization now appear in Delta without a restart.
- With Sort by set to Last Prompted or Last Response, prompting a subthread now moves its parent thread up the sidebar.
- Archiving or deleting the last thread in a sidebar project now collapses that project’s section, and unarchiving a thread expands its section again.
- The thread filter menu is more compact and shows current selections beside its submenus.
- Threads synced from Claude Code now show a notice when Claude declines a request.
- Agent-created subthreads that share the parent’s worktree now identify the parent in the composer placeholder.
- Open in Desktop App is available on the web while a shared thread is still loading.
🔧 Fixes and reliability
- When you reopen Delta after collaborators changed a shared worktree, files they deleted no longer come back, and changes you made to your folder in the meantime are saved to a fork the agent can merge.
- Switching a thread from Isolated Delta Worktree to an existing checkout no longer lets that checkout overwrite another checkout’s files.
- Delta no longer crashes when syntax highlighting updates after deleting text in a diff.
- Delta no longer crashes when reporting certain connection errors.
- Opening a thread while an agent is still working in it on another device no longer deletes its in-progress compaction summary or stops its thinking indicator early.
- Archiving a subthread no longer hides it from collaborators or closes it while they are working in it.
- Delta updates no longer fail because an agent or terminal started the app on macOS.
- Repositories in existing threads now recover from some history-loading errors without needing to be removed and added again.
- Keep Local Changes in a New Thread and Discard Local Changes no longer fail with “thread not found” on subthreads created on another device or by another person.
- Shared threads with older HTTPS checkouts now use your local checkout’s SSH connection instead of prompting for GitHub HTTPS credentials.
- delta thread show and other read-only thread commands no longer freeze the Delta window while reading large threads.
- Messages from other agents, such as a subthread’s result, no longer sometimes appear twice in a thread.
- People the agent mentions by name no longer appear as a bare @ in its replies.
- After reverting into a message you sent to a fork, you can now edit and resend it in the current thread.
- Model and thinking-level selectors now stay up to date when settings change in older threads.
- The Shared with You section no longer displays sign-in errors or a Retry button in place of shared threads.
- A thread’s add-project menu no longer lists projects from other organizations that can’t be added to it.
- Reviews now take their title from their latest change guide, even if you interrupted the first response.
- Files in languages installed from extensions are now highlighted when Delta reopens them at startup.
- Resizing the divider between the conversation and file pane no longer changes its width in other threads.
- Background terminal updates no longer leave large gaps or duplicate typing indicators in conversations.
- On mobile web, All Threads no longer resets the selected organization.
- Application menus on Linux and Windows now stay up to date after signing in or out, without opening a new window.
- Dialogs on Linux now match Delta’s theme and let you scroll through long details instead of cutting them off.
- Long commands no longer stretch the Running Terminals menu beyond the window.
- Links in terminal output no longer include a border or symbol printed right after them.

zh-CN.description: 与队友和编程智能体一起开发代码的多端协作环境。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Delta 把队友和编程智能体放进同一条共享会话里。对话与代码存在一起，每一处改动都锚定在它背后的思路上，因此产出这些代码的决策与提示词能和结果一起被回看。
可以在 Delta 应用里工作，也可以在终端里工作；DeltaDB 让两边落在同一条会话中。版本控制系统会把每次编辑连同它背后的对话一起记录下来，从 Claude Code 分享出去的会话可以在 Delta 应用里加入，反过来也一样。
邀请队友进入同一条会话，即可实时评审、评论，并与智能体协同工作。可以针对对话或任意一行代码留言，随着工作推进，评论始终锚在原来的位置。
